statement: A release driver and its shim tests were committed as written and linted but not run, because the authoring session could not execute them. Running them for the first time (cejel #393, 2026-10-02) gave 33 of 34 passing; the one failure was a static guard in the tests, not the driver: it grepped release.sh for 'git commit' and matched the driver's own header comment saying it never commits. Rule: a static grep guard over a script must exclude comment lines, and a script handed over unrun is reported as unrun until a run is seen. The fix is to scope the guard to code, not to loosen what it forbids.
